spec.name: sensor_arm
spec.description: Cantilevered sensor arm, 150 x 30 x 30 mm along x, fixed to the robot frame at x = 0 and carrying a 2 kg camera (about 20 N, gravity taken as -z) on a 20 x 20 mm plate centred on the x = 150 end face.

supports.note: Assumed: the arm attaches to the robot frame across the full x = 0 end face (clamped cantilever root).

loads.note: 2 kg camera, about 20 N; gravity assumed along -z.

passive.note: Keeps solid material under the 20 x 20 mm camera mounting plate.

assumptions: Robot frame attachment taken as the full x = 0 face, fully fixed.
